question: In which of the following years was the Indian Independence Act passed by the British Parliament?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1947**__.

__
 
• **In 1947 the Indian Independence Act passed by the British Parliament**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Indian Independence Act, 1947** received **royal assent** and entered into **force** on **18th July 1947.**

 
 
• The** Indian Independence Act, 1947** was an act of the **British Parliament** that partitioned **India **into **two independent** dominions of **India **and **Pakistan.**
 
• The** Act** decided to **grant independence** to **India** and **Pakistan** with effect from **15th August 1947.**
 
• **British suzerainty **over the **princely states **was to **end.** These states could decide to **join** either** Indi**a or **Pakistan** or remain **independent**. Over **560 states **decided to **merge with India.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• According to this act, Pakistan became independent on 14 August and India on 15 August 1947. Muhammad Ali Jinnah was appointed Governor-General of Pakistan and Lord Mountbatten became of India.
